caption: Every golf trip dies the same way...

props.headline: The group chat is where golf trips go to die.
It always starts the same way.
props.body: Someone says: 'We should plan a trip.' Everyone says: 'I'm in.' Then the group chat takes over.

props.label: MEANWHILE IN THE GROUP CHAT
props.headline: 47 unread messages.
props.body: No dates. No destination. No decisions.

props.quote: Three months later. Still no trip.

props.label: THERE'S A BETTER WAY
props.headline: One link. One source of truth. One trip that actually happens.
What 'one link' actually means.
props.body: Plan. Commit. Play. Settle. All in one place. The captain stays sane. The crew stays committed.
